name: Cinematic travel film
description: For music-led travel footage: no cuts (so natural sound and shot lengths stay as filmed), a place title near the start, a place-and-date card at the end and slow fades. Slow push-ins are added on longer shots. Beat-matched cutting, foley, speed ramps and grading are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

cleanup.reason: this footage is music- and scenery-led, and cutting 'pauses' would only chop the shots

beats.name: Strongest shot first
beats.guidance: Open on the single best image.

beats.name: Journey
beats.guidance: Cut on the beat of the music; 2 to 3 seconds per shot.

beats.name: Detail
beats.guidance: A close detail that sells the place.

beats.name: Place and date
beats.guidance: Name the place and the date.

effects.title: Slow push-ins
effects.description: A slow digital push-in on every shot of three seconds or more.

deferred.title: Beat-matched cuts
deferred.description: Cut the shots to the beats of the music. A music track can be added, but the editor cannot find the beats.

deferred.title: Colour grade
deferred.description: A LUT or grade, applied after converting log footage.

deferred.title: Foley and ambience
deferred.description: Layered natural sound over the score.

notes.text: Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
Drone flights usually need local permission or a licence; check the rules for where you fly, and for filming on private property.
Get consent from every identifiable person in the footage, and blur or crop anyone who has not agreed. Minors need a parent or guardian's consent.
